A.name: FAST_CRASH
A.signal: 5D Crash Velocity Top 10% of positive training observations

B.name: SUSTAINED_CRASH
B.signal: 10D Crash Velocity Top 10% of positive training observations

C.name: EXTREME_FAST_CRASH
C.signal: 5D Crash Velocity Top 5% of positive training observations

D.name: FAST_PLUS_DEEP
D.signal: 5D Crash Velocity Top 10% AND 20D drawdown-from-high deepest 20%
D.threshold: training-only positive velocity 90th percentile AND training-only drawdown 20th percentile

event_clustering.rule: For each candidate separately, qualifying observations separated by <=3 trading days are one event; an event ends after >3 trading days without another qualifying observation.
event_clustering.trough: descriptive only; prohibited as an entry

entry.rule: enter at first qualifying date adjusted close
entry.confirmation: diagnostic only; excluded from candidate selection

market_regime.rule: BULL close > MA200 and MA200 5D slope > 0; BEAR close < MA200 and MA200 5D slope < 0; otherwise TRANSITION
market_regime.use: diagnostic stratification only; not an entry filter

walk_forward.type: expanding window, annual fixed chronological OOS blocks
walk_forward.subsequent: add each completed OOS year to training, then test the next calendar year
walk_forward.threshold_policy: recompute every candidate percentile using only dates strictly before the OOS block

anti_tuning.rule: Known cases must not alter candidates, thresholds, clustering, entry, horizons, or walk-forward split.

l3_constraints: Do not add, discard, or alter candidates based on OOS results; report all A-D.
